agents.name: builtin-http
agents.description: Built-in bounded HTTP generator (no external tool required) — flows with correlation.

agents.name: k6
agents.description: k6 (external) — arrival-rate load, ramping scenarios, and multi-step flows with correlation (authenticated journeys at high rate).

agents.name: vegeta
agents.description: Vegeta (external) — fixed-rate load, runs phases sequentially (no multi-step flows).

agents.name: locust
agents.description: Locust (external, headless) — shared request pacing, supports multi-step flows; use k6/vegeta for phases.

agents.name: jmeter
agents.description: Apache JMeter (external, headless) — constant throughput, supports multi-step flows; heavy (JVM).

agents.name: gatling
agents.description: Gatling (native HTTP) — bounded concurrency and request rate, supports multi-step flows; JVM preparation required.

agents.name: iot-fleet
agents.description: One to three enrolled VPS Lab agents; bounded GET, shared caps of 15 RPS, 6 workers, 60 seconds.
